notes.title: Checkpoints
notes.content:
[h1]Checkpoints for saving progress mid-level[/h1]

Now you'll find checkpoints throughout the game.

Be sure to press the button to save progress. Press again to toggle it, if you ever wish to start at the beginning. 

Next time you start the level, you'll be set on the checkpoint's position, along with the cats you had nearby.

notes.title: Upcoming updates and fixes
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Improve chain physics.
    [*]Make spiked barricades destructible.
    [*]Fix damage flash effect glitch.
    [*]Stamina no longer will affect attack damage.
    [*]Tips and tutorials regarding controls, and potion effects.
    [*]Implement Steam Achievements.
    [*]Saved cats counter on island.
    [*]Make door keys unique.
[/list]

More to come!
